desc: Ideation: derive per-digit divisibility counting rules (1/2/5 trivial, 4/8 via last 2/3 digits, 3/6/9 via prefix digit sums, 7 via scaled prefix hash mod 7)
Implement the complete solution in `Solution.countSubstrings` with running counters (cnt3, cnt9, cnt7) and per-digit branches, querying counters before updating them
Test against examples ("12936" → 11, "5701283" → 18, "1010101010" → 25) and edge cases ("0" → 0, "7" → 1, trailing zeros, length-1/2 substrings for digits 4 and 8)
